scripts.prepare: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && bun --filter stitchkit build && bun --filter stitchkit-tui build && bun scripts/prepare-starter.ts
scripts.check: bun --filter stitchkit check && bun --filter stitchkit-tui check && bun --filter create-stitchkit check && bun run check:scripts
scripts.test: bun --filter stitchkit test && bun --filter stitchkit-tui test && bun --filter create-stitchkit test && bun test scripts/*.test.ts
scripts.build: bun run gen:llms && bun run gen:example-declarations && bun --filter stitchkit build && bun --filter stitchkit-tui build && bun --filter create-stitchkit build
scripts.lint: biome check --error-on-warnings . && bun run lint:template && bun run lint:agent-template && bun run lint:telegram-bot-template
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write . && cd packages/create-stitchkit/template && bun run lint:fix
scripts.agent-template-lane: cd packages/core && bun ../../scripts/package-build-lock.ts -- sh -c 'cd ../create-stitchkit/templates/agent && bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && bun run check && bun test && bun run build'
scripts.telegram-bot-template-lane: cd packages/core && bun ../../scripts/package-build-lock.ts -- sh -c 'cd ../create-stitchkit/templates/telegram-bot && bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && bun run check && bun test && bun run build'
scripts.test:release-metadata: bun test scripts/surface-cadence.test.ts scripts/release-notes.test.ts scripts/release-validate.test.ts scripts/release-unchanged.test.ts && cd packages/core && bun test tests/upgrade-plan.test.ts tests/reference-coverage.test.ts
